replies.author: Jahaj
replies.body:
If you are including retired players just saying that Brett Farve was the most unshakable.
I agree with most of your rankings, but Aaron Rodgers has one of the most up tempo offences, and is one of the best decision makers ever. Example: He caught both the Seahawks and the Chiefs with 12 men on the field twice. It proves how up tempo their offence is, and shows his smarts, because many other players wouldn't even notice the substitutions. He also caught the teams 8 times with a hard count, which resulted in 2 free TDs and 214 free yards, and that's just in 3 weeks. Also, Aaron Rodgers can scramble and run away from defenders, things Peyton Manning and Tom Brady can't do.
